def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (v:=grid[r][c])!=bg]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    used=set()
    # group by diagonal lines (both slopes)
    lines=[]
    rem=dict(((r,c),v) for r,c,v in cells)
    for slope in (1,-1):
        pts=list(rem.keys())
        seen=set()
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen: continue
            r,c=p
            # collect line
            line=[]
            rr,cc=r,c
            while (rr-slope,cc-1) in rem: rr,cc=rr-slope,cc-1
            while (rr,cc) in rem and (rr,cc) not in seen:
                # stay on same line: value consistent
                line.append((rr,cc)); seen.add((rr,cc)); rr,cc=rr+slope,cc+1
            if len(line)>=1:
                vals={rem[q] for q in line}
                lines.append((slope,line,vals))
    for slope,line,vals in lines:
        if len(vals)==1:
            v=vals.pop()
            # extend to edges
            for r in range(h):
                c=(r-line[0][0])+line[0][1] if slope==-1 else None
                # slope -1: c decreases as r increases: c = c0 - (r-r0) -> c = c0 + (r0 - r)
                # slope +1: c = c0 + (r-r0)
                if slope==-1: c=line[0][1]+(line[0][0]-r)
                else: c=line[0][1]+(r-line[0][0])
                if 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=v
        else:
            for r,c in line: out[r][c]=rem[(r,c)]
    # keep any multi-valued line cells as-is handled above
    return out
